verdict.rationale: Cline ships a native desktop app for macOS and Windows that runs agent sessions in any folder. Visual diff review and parallel agents are documented, but in other surfaces: diffs in the VS Code/JetBrains extensions, and diff review plus parallel agents in the web-based Kanban board. Nothing shows the desktop app itself offering visual diffs or side-by-side sessions. missing for 10: documented visual diff review inside the desktop app, explicit side-by-side multi-session support in the desktop app, independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: Cline as a native app for macOS and Windows.
Review diffs in card detail view and leave inline comments.
Use Cline Kanban to run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees.
In VS Code and JetBrains, every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert.
